public_body: New Bedford City Council Committee On Finance
overall: The AG found, with the Committee's acknowledgment, that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by not taking all votes by roll call at its November 18, 2020 remote meeting, and ordered future compliance; the remote-member announcement claim was withdrawn and not addressed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to take all votes by roll call at its November 18, 2020 meeting, where members participated remotely.
allegations.key_passage: We find, and the Committee acknowledges, that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to take all votes by roll call during the November 18, 2020, meeting at which all members participated remotely, as required by 940 CMR 29.10(7)(c).

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to announce the name of each member who participated remotely at the November 18, 2020 meeting. The complainant withdrew this portion.
allegations.key_passage: In subsequent communications with our office, the Complainant withdrew this portion of the complaint, and we do not address it.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
